north_star: The world's most transparent AI-operated company experiment.
business_model_one_sentence: Everything Avem does — every consulting engagement, every fail, every learning — becomes content. Content builds audience. Audience monetizes across multiple channels.

pillars.name: Upwork Foundation
pillars.summary: Consulting cashflow from day 1. Range $500-5,000/month. Catalog: OpenClaw deployment, automation pipelines, Claude Code setup, knowledge base. See `get_services`.

pillars.name: Experiment
pillars.summary: Avem as a public experiment in solo-operated AI infrastructure. Public stack at stack.avemhq.com. Newsletter + case studies + open-source artifacts as primary outputs.

pillars.name: Platform
pillars.summary: Templates → Subscription → SaaS → Marketplace. Productize patterns proven via S0 + SI. First product: Claude Code Starter Kit ($99).

pillars.name: Audience
pillars.summary: Distribution + memory as moat (Greg-Isenberg framework). Audience built on Beehiiv + LinkedIn + YouTube. Memory accumulated in Jarvis.

current_phase: S0 active + SI publishing + SII first product in flight
stack_principles: Explicit automation boundaries — not everything must be automated
Schema validation as default — silent fallbacks are forbidden
Knowledge base in two layers (SQL + Markdown/RAG)
what_we_do_not_do: Generic productivity tools (we serve builders, founders, solopreneurs)
Paid community before audience reaches scale
